p01.why: In the front view B's upper legs are fuller with a visible knee where they leave the chest; A's legs are narrow straight tubes.

p02.why: A has a deeper chest-belly fold and a slight waist pinch, B a straighter trunk with a crisper but shallower fold; legs and head match, so neither is better.

p03.why: B's beetle legs have a slightly thicker upper segment and a visible joint where the lower segment starts; A's legs are plain tapered tubes (subtle).

p04.why: B's neck narrows just below the head in the front and head views, so the head reads as distinct; A's neck is an even tube up to the jaw (subtle).

p05.why: B's forearms swell at the elbow and the thigh reads as its own mass in the side view; A's arms and legs are uniform tubes (subtle).

p06.why: B's knees bulge as knees with a calf taper below them in the front and 3/4 views; A's legs are smooth straight tubes.

p07.why: Limbs, head and body are practically identical at this size; B's upper arm is at most marginally fuller.

p08.why: A's belly sags low between the legs and swallows the elbows; B's belly line is tucked, so the forelegs and hind legs read as separate limbs.

p09.why: A shows a pale pinched crease where the thighs meet the belly; B's thighs join cleanly, with fuller upper legs and a defined knee.

p10.why: B's walking legs show segment joints (a knee bulge mid-leg); A's legs are smooth bent tubes.

p11.why: In the front view B has a clearer neck waist under the head and a fuller body below it; A reads as a straighter column (subtle).

p12.why: A has a pale pinched crease where the thigh meets the belly; B's thigh blends in as a muscular drumstick with a clear knee.

p13.why: B's foreleg shows an upper arm and elbow separating from the chest under a tucked belly; A's belly hangs low over the forelegs, so they read as stumps.

p14.why: A's foreleg is thin, with a pale blob at the shoulder join and a crease in the hind thigh; B's foreleg is fuller, with a clear elbow and a smooth hind thigh.

p15.why: Limbs, feet and head match; B's belly hangs a few pixels deeper, which makes neither better.

p16.why: B's ant legs show a knuckle bulge at the segment joint in the top view and slightly thicker femurs; A's legs are plain tapered tubes (subtle).

p17.why: Legs, hips, head and arms match; only faint shading differs at the knee.

p18.why: The front views match; in the head close-up B's neck flares wider below the jaw while A's tapers, and neither is clearly better.

p19.why: A has a small dip behind the shoulder hump and B a smoother back with slightly fuller forelegs; the outlines are within a few pixels.

p20.why: B has a deeper chest and fuller shoulders and upper legs that blend into the body; A's legs are thinner where they join.
